_comment: ADD-ON GROUPS — the five headings the add-ons are published under.
AN ADD-ON IS NOT A DIFFERENT KIND OF THING FROM A FEATURE. Before this
existed the eleven add-ons were hand-typed markup in index.html with
hard-coded prices, hand-typed index numbers and hand-typed group counts —
and one of them, Company Profile, had no Arabic label at all (docs/124
§1.4). They are now ordinary catalogue features that carry an
`addonGroup`, which is the only thing that made them a separate category:
where they are PUBLISHED, not what they are.
So the same row can be a package inclusion and a purchasable add-on
without being written twice — feat.marketing.ad_creative is exactly that
— and adding a twelfth add-on is one `addonGroup` on one feature, with
the index numbers and the counts generated.
`order` is publication order. Ids are permanent.
THE WHOLE NOUN PHRASE, not a numeral with a plural glued on. Arabic
counts one, two and three-to-ten differently, so `${n} إضافات` is wrong
for one and wrong for two. build-pricing.js already learned this for
packages; the same table, for the same reason.
